nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finite group and let $r$ be the number of conjugacy classes of $G$. Then there exist polynomials $p_1, \dots, p_r$ in $\mathbb{C}[x_g : g \in G]$ such that each $p_j$ is irreducible, $p_i$ and $p_j$ are not associated for $i \neq j$, and the group determinant of $G$ equals $\prod_{j=1}^{r} p_j^{\deg p_j}$, where $\deg p_j$ is the total degree of $p_j$.
nodes.title: Frobenius determinant theorem

nodes.summary: For a finite group $G$, the group determinant $\Theta(G)$ is the determinant of the group matrix of $G$, the $G \times G$ matrix over $\mathbb{C}[x_g : g \in G]$ whose entry at $(g, h)$ is the variable $x_{gh}$; it is a polynomial in these variables.
nodes.title: Group determinant

nodes.summary: For a finite group $G$, the group matrix of Dedekind and Frobenius is the $G \times G$ matrix over the polynomial ring $\mathbb{C}[x_g : g \in G]$ whose entry at $(g, h)$ is the variable $x_{gh}$.
nodes.title: Group matrix

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
